page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Right margin: one marginal note beside the start of the paragraph beginning "Filia sacerdotis fornicans". Running head at top. Gathering signature centred at foot.

main_text.p: consanguinitas sit, sive affinitas, sequenti capite fusiùs peculiariter persequemur.
Impudicitia naturalis inter illos, qui nullâ nos propinquitate attingunt, aut cum solutis personis committitur; aut cum sponsa alterius, aut cum uxore proximi, in conjugio nimirum consummato.

Soluta persona, aut filia est, honestæ alioquin conditionis; aut meretrix, & publicum prostibulum; aut menstruata mulier, ut ἐν πλάτει[?], hac solutæ personæ specie nunc utar, cùm alioqui menstrui fluxus solutis, & conjugatis mulieribus communis sit.
Filia aut sacerdotis est; aut alterius cujuspiam, nempe (ut vulgò vocant) laici.

Filia sacerdotis fornicansDe filia sa-cerdotis fornicante[?], ignis supplicio le-ge divinâ adjudicatur, cùm tamen reliquarum tribuum filiæ nuptæ, tam gravi pœnâ non plecte-rentur, sed tantùm aut sponsa, aut uxor alterius, quemadmodum septimi hujus præcepti appen-dices politicæ denunciant. In qua lege aliquid ceremoniale & typicum est, aliquid etiâ morale, quod æquitatem habet perpetuam. Ceremonia-le est, pœna ignis, aut vivicomburium, ut veteres Christiani dicebant. Quia enim sacerdotes ty-pum gerebant Christi, sacerdotis unici & summi nostri: singularis ab ipsis requirebatur sancti-monia externa, ut sanctitate ac puritatem Christi internam ac perfectam, omnibusq; numeris absolutam in se præfigurarent. Si enim immun-diciem quamcunq; legalem, sive externam, sibi contrahebant, sacramentum & mysterium Chri-

page.notes: The Greek word after "ut" is printed in a worn form; read as ἐν πλάτει with doubt, marked [?]. The marginal note is printed in two lines split by a hyphen after "sa-"; the final letters of "fornicante" are unclear and marked [?]. The text at the foot of the column ("Chri-") runs over to the next page. No catchword is visible.
